notes.title: Beta 1.0.0.10.2
notes.content:
[h3]Update 1.0.0.10.2 (21/04/25 - 27/05/25)[/h3]
•	Updated to unreal engine 5.6 Beta
•	Many plugins have been disabled: DLSS 4, FSR 3, Online plugins.
•	Some things have been changed in the patch notes of version

notes.title: Beta 1.0.0.10.1
notes.content:
[h3]Update 1.0.0.10.1 (14/04/25 - 21/04/25)[/h3]
•	Fixed a problem that did not allow the use of Nanite that was related to DirectX.
•	Minor changes have been made to the race.
•	Some visual bugs have been fixed.
•	More models have been configured to have Nanite.
•	Changed the play icon in the playable menu.
•	Fixed a very large shadow bug, which caused inconsistent shadows everywhere.
•	Nanite has been disabled (due to a bug with shaders that needs to be fixed by Epic Games developers).

notes.title: Beta 1.0.0.10
notes.content:
[h3]Update 1.0.0.10 (20/03/25 - 14/04/25)[/h3]
• Added a preliminary version of Actived Defense (DRM) to the game (disabled, until it is finished). 
• Fixed a bug related to the main menu race.
• Nanite has been added to almost all models in the game.
• A new settings menu has been created to change the Nanite settings and lower the vertexes of the models, which is accessed from the graphics settings menu.
• Fixed some problems with the dots in front of each change in the patch notes.
• Significant improvements in the main playable menu race.
• New maps have been added to the frantic mode.
